Patch release. Doctor health alerts now fire when a new check starts failing even if another equally severe check is already failing.

npm `@canonry/canonry@latest` is `5.3.1`.

- **Notify on the failing set, not only the headline code.** Health alerts used to fire only when the worst check's `(status, code)` changed. Same features as the v0.3.0 GitHub tag: local Kev/Laya System One, admit-gate fix, doctor/healthz.

## Summary
Local **Kev / Laya / System One** adjudicator backends. Default cloud **Jev** Decisions path unchanged.

## Install
```bash
npx @kushalicious/jevcache@0.3.0
# or latest
npx @kushalicious/jevcache@latest
```

(If you see `0.3.1` as well, same features — use either.)

See [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/kushals256/jevcache/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Summary
Temporal freshness for jevcache so same-intent hits don’t serve stale answers.

- Precision-first classes: `live` (bypass) / `short` (~15m) / `stable` (TTL_SECONDS) / `durable`
- admit-v2: same-call `reuse_fresh` when candidate age ≥ 5m (demos stay HIT)
- Rollback: `FRESHNESS_MODE=off`
- Fixes: `X-Jevcache-Bypass` uses Authorization; stream bypass respects `MOCK_UPSTREAM`

## Install
```bash
npx @kushalicious/jevcache@0.1.6 start --demo
# or
npx @kushalicious/jevcache@latest start --demo
```
